quest.title: Yachimatahiko's Trial
quest.description: Accepting the trial, you prepare to go to The Narrows to search for The Emanant Skylight

talks.objective: Investigate the water in the pool during Evernight
Talk to the afterimage in front of the seal

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: I am Uda of the Jibashiri. Hero of Sangonomiya, I acknowledge that you are worthy to take on this challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: I am in charge of the trial of "wisdom." Go forth and solve all the puzzles to return the Flames of the High Gate to their places.

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: It is not bravery that advances bereft of wisdom, but foolhardiness instead!

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: I will await your completion of the challenge at the Tower of the Three Realms above.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: Go forth, hero of Sangonomiya, and take on the challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: Return all the Flames of the High Gate to their places.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: I, Uda of the Jibashiri, acknowledge your great valor.

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: Indeed, you are both "extensive and meticulous" in your wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How can you tell a person's character from these trials?

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: To be honest, these words are praises that the Divine Priestess used to bestow upon skilled youths. They eventually came to be written on pennants at the Jibashiri headquarters.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate

dialogues.speaker: Uda
dialogues.text: I am Uda of the Jibashiri. Unrelated people may not enter.

talks.objective: Release all the Flames of the High Gate
